# Collections and items

Collections are typed content lists (fields, items, statuses). Repeaters on pages read them (`source=` in the outline).

[`collection.list`](#collectionlist) · [`collection.read`](#collectionread) · [`collection.create`](#collectioncreate) · [`collection.update`](#collectionupdate) · [`collection.delete`](#collectiondelete) · [`item.list`](#itemlist) · [`item.read`](#itemread) · [`item.history`](#itemhistory) · [`item.create`](#itemcreate) · [`item.update`](#itemupdate) · [`item.delete`](#itemdelete) · [`item.reorder`](#itemreorder) · [`item.import`](#itemimport) · [`item.rollback`](#itemrollback) · [`item.setStatus`](#itemsetstatus)

## collection.list

List the draft collections of the site, in order, each with its fields and its number of items. Collections are versioned with the site: publish copies them with their published items, and the public site serves those.

- permission `site.read` (admin, editor); class `read`; writes nothing.
- Input: `{}`.

Output: { collections: ({ collection: { uid: uuid, key: string (max 40), label: string (min 1, max 80) \| Record<locale, …>, fields: (… \| … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …)[] (≤40), titleField: string, slugField: string, position: integer ≥0 }, itemCount: integer ≥0 })[] }

Example input:

```json
{}
```

## collection.read

Read a draft collection: its key, label, fields, title field and slug field. Collections are versioned with the site: publish copies them with their published items, and the public site serves those.

|---|---|---|
| `collectionId` | uuid | yes |

```json
{"collectionId":"a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d"}
```

## collection.create

Create a collection with its typed fields. The key is unique on the site and never changes: blueprints, repeaters and dynamic pages name the collection by it. Collections are versioned with the site: publish copies them with their published items, and the public site serves those.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `collections`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `collection` | object | yes |
| `collection.key` | string (max 40) | yes |
| `collection.label` | string (min 1, max 80) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 80)> | yes |
| `collection.fields` | ({ key: string, label: string (min 1, max 80) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 80)>, localized?: boolean, required?: boolean, help?: string (min 1, max 240), type: "text", multiline?: boolean } \| { key: string, label: string (min 1, max 80) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 80)>, localized?: boolean, required?: bo… (full schema: discover_operations) | yes |
| `collection.titleField` | string | yes |
| `collection.slugField` | string | yes |

Output: { collection: { uid: uuid, key: string (max 40), label: string (min 1, max 80) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 80)>, fields: ({ key: string, label: … \| …, localized: boolean, required: boolean, help?: string (min 1, max 240), type: "text", multiline?: boolean } \| { key: string, label: … \| …, localized: boolean, req… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"collection":{"key":"events","label":{"it":"Eventi","en":"Events"},"titleField":"title","slugField":"title","fields":[{"key":"title","type":"text","label":{"it":"Titolo","en":"Title"},"localized":true,"required":true},{"key":"date","type":"date","label":{"it":"Data","en":"Date"},"required":true},{"key":"venue","type":"text","label":{"it":"Luogo","en":"Venue"}},{"key":"poster","type":"media","label":"Poster"},{"key":"photos","type":"mediaList","label":{"it":"Foto","en":"Photos"}},{"key":"programme","type":"file","label":{"it":"Programma (PDF)","en":"Programme (PDF)"},"localized":true},{"key":"speakers","type":"reference","label":{"it":"Relatori","en":"Speakers"},"collection":"team","multiple":true},{"key":"kind","type":"select","label":{"it":"Tipo","en":"Kind"},"options":[{"value":"talk","label":{"it":"Incontro","en":"Talk"}},{"value":"screening","label":{"it":"Proiezione","en":"Screening"}}]},{"key":"chapters","type":"list","label":{"it":"Capitoli","en":"Chapters"},"fields":[{"key":"time","type":"number","label":"Seconds"},{"key":"title","type":"text","label":"Title","localized":true}]}]}}
```

## collection.update

Patch the label, fields, title field or slug field of a collection. A field removed or retyped is refused while an item holds a value for it. Collections are versioned with the site: publish copies them with their published items, and the public site serves those.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `collection:{collectionId}`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `collectionId` | uuid | yes |
| `patch` | object | yes |
| `patch.label` | string (min 1, max 80) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 80)> |  |
| `patch.fields` | ({ key: string, label: string (min 1, max 80) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 80)>, localized?: boolean, required?: boolean, help?: string (min 1, max 240), type: "text", multiline?: boolean } \| { key: string, label: string (min 1, max 80) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 80)>, localized?: boolean, required?: bo… (full schema: discover_operations) |  |
| `patch.titleField` | string |  |
| `patch.slugField` | string |  |

Output: { collection: { uid: uuid, key: string (max 40), label: string (min 1, max 80) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 80)>, fields: ({ key: string, label: … \| …, localized: boolean, required: boolean, help?: string (min 1, max 240), type: "text", multiline?: boolean } \| { key: string, label: … \| …, localized: boolean, req… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"collectionId":"a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d","patch":{"label":{"it":"Eventi e incontri","en":"Events and talks"}}}
```

## collection.delete

Delete a collection and its draft items; published versions keep theirs until a publish. Collections are versioned with the site: publish copies them with their published items, and the public site serves those.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `collections`, `collection:{collectionId}`; needs `"confirmed": ["destructive"]`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `collectionId` | uuid | yes |

Output: { success: true }

Example input:

```json
{"collectionId":"a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d"}
```

## item.create

Add a draft item at the end of a collection. Its values are checked against the collection's fields and the site's locales; a reference names an item of the referenced collection, and a media or file value a media row of the site. Collections are versioned with the site: publish copies them with their published items, and the public site serves those.

- permission `content.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `collection:{collectionId}`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `collectionId` | uuid | yes |
| `slug` | string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 120)> |  |
| `values` | Record<string, string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (… \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …)[] \| Record<string, … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …>)[] \| Record<string, string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (… \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …)[] \| Record<string, … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …>>> | yes |

Output: { collectionId: uuid, item: { uid: uuid, status: "draft" \| "published", slug: string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 120)>, values: Record<string, string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (… \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …)[] \| Record<string, … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …>>, position: integer ≥0, updatedAt: string } }

Example input:

```json
{"collectionId":"a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d","slug":{"it":"giornata-del-recupero","en":"recovery-day"},"values":{"title":{"it":"Giornata del recupero","en":"Recovery day"},"date":"2026-11-21","venue":"Teatro Comunale","poster":"2c3d4e5f-6a7b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f","photos":["2c3d4e5f-6a7b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"],"speakers":["c3d4e5f6-a7b8-4c9d-8e0f-2a3b4c5d6e7f"]}}
```

## item.update

Patch the slug or values of an item: `values` is merged key by key, and a null removes a key. The merged values are checked like item.create's. Collections are versioned with the site: publish copies them with their published items, and the public site serves those.

- permission `content.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `collection:{collectionId}`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `collectionId` | uuid | yes |
| `itemId` | uuid | yes |
| `patch` | object | yes |
| `patch.slug` | string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 120)> |  |
| `patch.values` | Record<string, string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (string \| number \| boolean \| null \| …[] \| Record<string, …>)[] \| Record<string, string \| number \| boolean \| null \| …[] \| Record<string, …>> \| null> |  |

Output: { collectionId: uuid, item: { uid: uuid, status: "draft" \| "published", slug: string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 120)>, values: Record<string, string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (… \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …)[] \| Record<string, … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …>>, position: integer ≥0, updatedAt: string } }

Example input:

```json
{"collectionId":"a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d","itemId":"b2c3d4e5-f6a7-4b8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e","patch":{"values":{"venue":"Sala civica","photos":null}}}
```

## item.delete

Delete a draft item; the published versions keep it until a publish, and item.rollback can bring it back. Collections are versioned with the site: publish copies them with their published items, and the public site serves those.

- permission `content.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `collection:{collectionId}`; needs `"confirmed": ["destructive"]`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `collectionId` | uuid | yes |
| `itemId` | uuid | yes |

Output: { success: true }

Example input:

```json
{"collectionId":"a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d","itemId":"b2c3d4e5-f6a7-4b8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e"}
```

## item.reorder

Reorder the items of a collection: `itemIds` names every item once, in the new order. Collections are versioned with the site: publish copies them with their published items, and the public site serves those.

- permission `content.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `collection:{collectionId}`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `collectionId` | uuid | yes |
| `itemIds` | uuid[] | yes |

Output: { itemIds: uuid[] }

Example input:

```json
{"collectionId":"a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d","itemIds":["c3d4e5f6-a7b8-4c9d-8e0f-2a3b4c5d6e7f","b2c3d4e5-f6a7-4b8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e"]}
```

## item.import

Add many draft items at once, all or none. A media, media list or file value names each media row by its id or by the exact filename of a file in the media library. Collections are versioned with the site: publish copies them with their published items, and the public site serves those.

- permission `content.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `collection:{collectionId}`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `collectionId` | uuid | yes |
| `rows` | ({ slug?: string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 120)>, values: Record<string, string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (… \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …)[] \| Record<string, … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …>> })[] (≤500) | yes |

Output: { collectionId: uuid, items: ({ uid: uuid, status: "draft" \| "published", slug: string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 120)>, values: Record<string, string \| number \| boolean \| null \| …[] \| Record<string, …>>, position: integer ≥0, updatedAt: string })[] }

Example input:

```json
{"collectionId":"a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d","rows":[{"values":{"title":"Open day","date":"2026-12-05","poster":"open-day-poster.jpg"}},{"slug":"winter-talk","values":{"title":{"it":"Incontro d'inverno","en":"Winter talk"},"date":"2027-01-16","poster":"2c3d4e5f-6a7b-4c8d-9e0f-1a2b3c4d5e6f"}}]}
```

## item.rollback

Restore an item of the draft to how a published version held it: its slug, values and status. When that version did not hold the item, the rollback removes it from the draft. Collections are versioned with the site: publish copies them with their published items, and the public site serves those.

- permission `content.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `collection:{collectionId}`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `collectionId` | uuid | yes |
| `itemId` | uuid | yes |
| `versionId` | uuid | yes |

Output: { collectionId: uuid, item: { uid: uuid, status: "draft" \| "published", slug: string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 120)>, values: Record<string, string \| number \| boolean \| null \| …[] \| Record<string, …>>, position: integer ≥0, updatedAt: string } \| null }

Example input:

```json
{"collectionId":"a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d","itemId":"b2c3d4e5-f6a7-4b8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e","versionId":"8b9c0d1e-2f3a-4b4c-8d5e-6f7a8b9c0d1e"}
```

## item.setStatus

Set an item's status: a published item is served by the next publication.publish, a draft item is not. Collections are versioned with the site: publish copies them with their published items, and the public site serves those.

- permission `content.publish` (admin, editor, workspace owner); class `transaction`; writes `collection:{collectionId}`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `collectionId` | uuid | yes |
| `itemId` | uuid | yes |
| `status` | "draft" \| "published" | yes |

Output: { collectionId: uuid, item: { uid: uuid, status: "draft" \| "published", slug: string (min 1, max 120) \| Record<locale, string (min 1, max 120)>, values: Record<string, string \| number \| boolean \| null \| (… \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …)[] \| Record<string, … \| … \| … \| … \| … \| …>>, position: integer ≥0, updatedAt: string } }

Example input:

```json
{"collectionId":"a1b2c3d4-e5f6-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d","itemId":"b2c3d4e5-f6a7-4b8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e","status":"published"}
```
